Description: Current use of any modern method of contraception (married women)
Full_definition: Percentage of currently married or in union women currently using any modern method of contraception.

Description: Antenatal visits for pregnancy: 4+ visits, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of women who had a live birth in the two years preceding the survey who had 4+ antenatal care visits.

Description: Assistance during delivery from a skilled provider, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of live births in the two years preceding the survey assisted by a skilled provider. Skilled provider usually includes doctor, nurse, midwife and auxiliary nurse or midwife, unless specified otherwise for a specific survey.

Description: Place of delivery: Health facility, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of live births  in the two years preceding the survey delivered at a health facility.

Description: Place of delivery: Public facility, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of live births in the two  years preceding the survey delivered at a public facility.

Description: Place of delivery: Private facility, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of live births in the two  years preceding the survey delivered at a private facility.

Description: Place of delivery: At home, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of live births in the two  years preceding the survey delivered at home.

Description: Newborn postnatal check-up, 2 years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of last births in the two years preceding the survey who had their first postnatal checkup within the first two days after birth.

Description: Children 12–23 months who had received MCV1 vaccination
Full_definition: Percentage of children 12-23 months who had received Measles vaccination.

Description: Children 12–23 months who had received DPT3 vaccination
Full_definition: Percentage of children 12-23 months who had received DPT 3 vaccination.

Description: Children 12–23 months with no vaccinations
Full_definition: Percentage of children 12-23 months who had received no vaccinations.

Description: Children under age 5 who slept under an insecticide-treated net (ITN)
Full_definition: Percentage of children under age 5 who slept under an insecticide treated net (ITN) the night before the survey.

Description: Children under age 5 with diarrhea who were treated with either ORS or RHF in the two weeks preceding the survey
Full_definition: Percentage of children born in the five  years preceding the survey with diarrhea in the two weeks preceding the survey who received either oral rehydration solution (ORS) or recommended home fluids (RHF).

Description: Women who are literate
Full_definition: Percentage of women who are literate.

Description: Women who own a mobile phone
Full_definition: Percentage of women who own a mobile phone.

Description: Women with secondary or higher education
Full_definition: Percentage of women with secondary or higher education.

Description: Population in the lowest two wealth quintiles
Full_definition: Percentage of the de jure population in the lowest two wealth quintiles.
Chapter: Chapter 02 - Housing Characteristics And Household Population

Description: Deaths per 1000 live births in the first month of life in the five years preceding the survey
Full_definition: Deaths per 1000 live births in the first month of life in the five years preceding the survey.

Description: Children under age 5 who are stunted (HAZ < -2)
Full_definition: Percentage of children under age 5 stunted (below -2 SD of height for age according to the WHO standard).
Chapter: Chapter 11 - Nutrition Of Children And Adults

Description: Children under age 5 who are wasted (WHZ < -2)
Full_definition: Percentage of children under age 5 wasted (below -2 SD of weight for height according to the WHO standard).
Chapter: Chapter 11 - Nutrition Of Children And Adults
